action_inputs.description: Terraform variable name/value pairs to apply: a JSON object in the built-in dialog (pre-filled with this deployment's current values), or the variables panel of a custom action form. Only variables this deployment already manages may be set (unknown keys are rejected before anything is written); a missing or blank value leaves that variable unchanged. Do not paste secrets into this plaintext field: sensitive variables are never shown and a non-blank value for one is rejected.
action_inputs.label: Parameters (JSON)
action_inputs.name: parameters

dialog_message: Edit this deployment's Terraform variables. The change is planned in its HCP Terraform workspace and the job PAUSES for plan review before anything is applied: 'Continue Job' approves and applies the plan; canceling the job discards the run and restores the previous values. Only variables this deployment already manages may be set; a blank or missing value keeps its current value. Sensitive variables are never shown and cannot be edited here -- update them on the workspace in HCP Terraform.
label: Terraform Update
